new.description: scan exports against exports-map reachability and cross-module references
the pin over src/ and harness/, plus the scanner's own flagging case

summary: Promote the absence verdict: a pin that reds on an export the exports map cannot reach and no other module references
acceptance: the suite carries a pin that reds on an unearned export in src/ or harness/ and is green on the tip
tests: the export scan flags an export that no other module references and the exports map cannot reach
pins: every src/ and harness/ export is reached by the package exports map or referenced from another module
notes: References resolve through the TS compiler API — a namespace import plus property access counts, a doc-comment mention does not; a test counts as a consumer. Reachability starts at both `exports` map entries and follows re-export and exported-type chains, so `StandardSchemaV1`'s vendored namespace members stay earned. Vacuity guard: assert the scanned set is non-empty before the emptiness assertion. The bullet's shrink to a pointer is an operator edit — rules sit outside build's fence.
